verdict.rationale: Gide's Venture & Growth Tech practice explicitly claims to advise 'from seed capital to IPOs' and cites material deal volume/awards, showing a stated early-stage financing practice, but there is no mention of SAFEs, convertible notes, ABSA/BSA-AIR or similar convertible instruments, nor any published explainers or forms specific to those instruments. missing for 10: explicit SAFE/convertible-instrument expertise, published explainers or template forms for pre-seed/seed convertible financings, independent corroboration of such deal work.
